summary: Investigate the living vein, survive the cave-in, travel two days below, read the Sunken Hall, escape the wretch gallery, and reach the isolated hilltop

turn.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turn.text: Open the drift or tell us what happened inside it.

turn.speaker: char_0R5AN25NJFB2GFQPC96JK85SH4
turn.text: We followed a new seam through black rootstone. Three cutters said the wall was warm. Then the tally bell rang from underground.

turn.speaker: char_6B6FGKREZM4RAECD6ZSFQXX74B
turn.text: You cut a membrane after I marked it sleeping.

turn.speaker: char_0R5AN25NJFB2GFQPC96JK85SH4
turn.text: I marked it unproductive. The guild collector marked it overdue.

turn.speaker: char_0R5AN25NJFB2GFQPC96JK85SH4
turn.text: One pump tender never came out. The others refuse to go past the green lamp line.

turn.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turn.text: The line is green here in daylight.

turn.speaker: char_0R5AN25NJFB2GFQPC96JK85SH4
turn.text: That is why I am not opening the gate.

turn.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turn.text: The gate bolt was drawn this morning. Someone opened it already.

turn.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turn.text: No. We are finished pretending the danger is behind the gate.

turn.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turn.text: You lead us to the green line. Tillo stays above and rings three times if the fork turns away.

recollection.summary: Jorund breached a warm seam under production pressure, lost a pump tender, and discovered the sealed gate had been opened again.
recollection.interpretation: The mine foreman concealed danger to protect workers and output at the same time; he is culpable but necessary.

recollection.summary: Animals avoid the spoil boundary and someone reopened the dangerous drift after Jorund sealed it.
recollection.interpretation: The threat is already moving independently of the mine's formal gates.

recollection.summary: A pump tender remains missing below a warm seam while miners refuse to cross the lamp's green line.
recollection.interpretation: Rescue is still possible and gives moral weight to entering despite the risk.

recollection.summary: The lamp reacts at the yard and the warm seam lies through black rootstone rather than ordinary ore.
recollection.interpretation: The mine has intersected a larger active structure rather than an isolated amber pocket.

recollection.summary: The sealed gate's bolt was operated recently despite Jorund's refusal to reopen it.
recollection.interpretation: Someone inside or outside the crew is maintaining access to the concealed drift.

recollection.summary: The guild hunters found every omission and mechanical contradiction before entering the drift.
recollection.interpretation: If they die, his concealment will be harder to excuse than the original breach.

recollection.summary: Jorund cut a membrane the dowser had marked sleeping because the guild collection was overdue.
recollection.interpretation: The Blackroot handling rules failed because production pressure rewards violating them.

frontmatter.title: Saint Orra Mine

observations.text: No bird, hare, or insect crosses the boundary between spruce litter and amber spoil.
The omitted drifts on Jorund's tally correspond to the two places where the ground presses against her teeth.
Fresh knife cuts have removed two drift totals from the official tally board.
The Saint Orra lamp changes from yellow to green whenever Jorund points it toward the sealed drift.
Jorund keeps his lower-drift map inside his coat and one hand on the drift bell rope.
Fresh graphite on the gate bolt shows it was drawn after Jorund claims to have sealed it.

author_constraints: Jorund still does not know the Blackroot Compact.
The party enters for rescue and investigation, not because they understand amber.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Saint Orra Mine

The mine negotiation strips away the last procedural excuse. A worker may remain below, the sealed gate has been used, and every instrument points into the omitted drift.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Enter Saint Orra's Sealed Drift
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Enter Saint Orra's Sealed Drift

Jorund opens the drift and guides the company past abandoned cutting stations. Amber seams brighten behind black rootstone whenever the party speaks, as if sound is arriving before them.

operations.title: The Living Amber Vein Answers the Party
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Living Amber Vein Answers the Party

The drift opens onto a membrane of liquid-gold amber threaded between petrified roots. It repeats the party's footfalls a heartbeat late and briefly shows five other silhouettes walking inside it.

operations.title: A Mine Wretch Phases Out of the Living Vein
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# A Mine Wretch Phases Out of the Living Vein

A long-bodied wretch emerges from the vein wearing the pump tender's lamp face and the claws of a cave bear. It repeats Jorund's orders before he speaks them, striking each place the foreman is about to indicate.

operations.title: The Saint Orra Drift Collapses
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Saint Orra Drift Collapses

Veyra scorches the membrane to force the wretch solid. The living vein contracts through the rootstone, snapping old support timbers in sequence. Jorund throws his map and mine lamp across the fracture before the roof comes down between him and the party.

operations.title: Jorund Is Lost Behind the Collapse
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# Jorund Is Lost Behind the Collapse

The party hears Jorund strike the far side of the rock three times, then one final blow farther away. No voice follows. The main drift and surface bell rope are buried.

value.title: After the Cave-In

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Names and injuries. Quickly.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Sylvi. Shoulder cut. Air is moving from below us.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Garran. Old frost wound, new bruising. The lamp survived.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: Veyra. Hearing the vein through the stone. I would prefer not to.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Pip. Uninjured in all morally significant ways. I have Jorund's map.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Jorund?

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Three strikes. Then one moving away. Nothing now.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: We dig until the air fails or he answers.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: The dust is settling toward the lower fissure. The surface side has no breath.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The map ends at OLD WATER beneath us. There are older passages beyond the mine work.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We mark this chamber, take the lower air, and return for Jorund from outside.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Say it as a promise, not a plan.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We come back for him.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# After the Cave-In

The party inventories itself, attempts to hear Jorund, and makes the consequential decision to follow lower airflow rather than die digging toward a sealed surface.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Choose the Lower Air
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Choose the Lower Air

After hours of digging and no further answer, Sylvi proves the lower fissure carries breathable air. Pip copies the collapse chamber onto Jorund's map, Garran marks the return promise, and Rhea leads the company into passages older than Saint Orra.

frontmatter.title: Cave-In Dark

observations.text: Dust threads flatten toward a black fissure below while the collapsed drift side remains still.
The living vein repeats their heartbeats through several yards of stone with one extra beat among them.
Jorund's map ends at a lower annotation marked OLD WATER and a passage he never inked.
Three distant blows answer from behind the collapse; the fourth arrives from farther away.
The party has one day of lamp oil and less than two days of food if rationed.

author_constraints: The party believes the lower route may return toward the surface; it does not.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Cave-In Dark

The catastrophe converts investigation into expedition. The party has no surface route, limited light, and a promise it may not be able to keep.

recollection.summary: The surface drift had no air; the lower fissure did. The party promised to return for Jorund and chose movement over a fatal dig.
recollection.interpretation: Leadership below means selecting which obligation can be postponed without pretending it is discharged.

recollection.summary: Airflow proved the only viable route was down into older water passages.
recollection.interpretation: The mine is built across a preexisting underground ecology the surface crews do not understand.

recollection.summary: Jorund answered three times before moving away; Rhea promised the party would return.
recollection.interpretation: A promise to the absent is still a threshold the living can violate.

recollection.summary: The vein repeated six heartbeats for five people and the old map points to passages below mine construction.
recollection.interpretation: The amber network may preserve or simulate forms independently of visible wretches.

recollection.summary: The lower map annotation and airflow offered a route; the collapse chamber is now the first reliable point on his underground survey.
recollection.interpretation: Maps become promises when people depend on the return line.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Cross the Black Water
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Cross the Black Water

The lower route becomes a flooded throat. Rhea anchors a rope across, Sylvi follows blind fish toward moving water, and the party crosses while amber threads beneath the pool imitate the shadows of swimming animals that are not present.

operations.title: The Party Finds an Old Underground Camp
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Party Finds an Old Underground Camp

Beyond the black water they find a centuries-old camp: stone fire ring, bone needles, and soot marks deliberately placed over amber-lit root cracks. Someone lived below long enough to learn darkness was safer than memory-light.

value.title: Second Night Below

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: We have moved eleven map lengths east and three down. That is either excellent progress or a very specific grave.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Eat before the jokes become strategy.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: I have half a road blessing left and no road. We may need to rename it.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: There are blind fish in the black water. Real ones. The amber has not emptied everything.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The roots under the water glow when we remember something aloud.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Then we remember silently.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: I remember owing three men money. The roots remain unimpressed.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Say something that hurt.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: I once locked myself in a customs vault for six hours because I had forged the key backward.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: They brightened.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: No more experiments with our own fear.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: That may be the first sensible rule anyone has made about amber.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: The guild had rules. It kept them from us.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: And Tillo knew the word quick before the chest moved.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: When we surface, the guild answers before we take another contract.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Second Night Below

The party tests the glowing roots by speaking memories, then recognizes that the guild possessed operational rules it withheld.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Blackwater Below

observations.text: Blind white fish occupy the flowing channel but avoid every amber-lit root.
Animal-shaped shadows swim beneath the crossing although the water around the rope is empty.
The submerged roots brighten when Pip describes a humiliating frightened memory and dim when he jokes without believing it.
Ancient soot has been packed over every amber crack surrounding the abandoned camp.
The party has one full meal left and enough lamp oil for perhaps another day.

author_constraints: The roots respond to emotionally salient memory, but the party cannot yet prove whether they store or merely attract it.
The party's growing suspicion of the guild remains inference, not knowledge of the Blackroot Compact.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Blackwater Below

Two days underground make the group into a real company. Hunger and darkness reduce their theories to the observations they are willing to trust.

recollection.summary: Amber-lit roots brightened when Pip recalled genuine fear, and Tillo and the guild already had rules for quick amber.
recollection.interpretation: The guild concealed practical hazard knowledge from workers and hunters who were expected to handle the material.

recollection.summary: Real blind fish avoid amber roots while emotionally charged speech brightens them.
recollection.interpretation: Amber changes behavior across living ecosystems before it produces visible monsters.
recollection.emotional_impression: relief at living tracks, then alarm

recollection.summary: The roots answered painful memory, not ordinary words, and old inhabitants covered them in soot.
recollection.interpretation: Whatever amber stores or calls, the danger is tied to remembered suffering more closely than to death itself.

recollection.summary: The roots brighten for emotionally real memories and respond weakly to fabricated statements.
recollection.interpretation: Amber may be a medium for structured lived impressions rather than a source of free magical energy.

recollection.summary: His genuine humiliation brightened the roots, proving that the underground system distinguishes performed speech from felt recollection.
recollection.interpretation: The caves are reading them, which makes mapping space alone insufficient.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Find the Sunken Hall
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Find the Sunken Hall

Beyond the old camp, dressed stone emerges from the cavern wall. A stair descends into a hall built around amber-bearing roots, with murals showing hunters and prey dissolving into the same golden lattice.

operations.title: Veyra Reads the Memory-Sap Tablet
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# Veyra Reads the Memory-Sap Tablet

Veyra translates the hall tablet: amber is golden sap after a buried root has remembered a wound; fresh terror can return hunter and hunted without distinguishing them. Garran rejects his earlier soul theory, while Pip copies every line onto the back of Jorund's map.

operations.title: The Amber Reliquary Opens Under Pressure

effects.value: open and carrying five fresh shadow-impressions

operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Amber Reliquary Opens Under Pressure

The breathing floor closes the route back. Pip opens the reliquary because its lattice is the only mechanism named for quieting an awakened path. The amber lattice inside unfolds like roots in water and absorbs the party's nearest shadows.

value.title: The Sunken Hall Debate

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: These stairs were built from below upward. The tool marks face the wrong way for a mine entrance.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: No animal bone in the hall. Only teeth placed around the stone box.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The tablet calls amber 'golden sap after the root has remembered the wound.'

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Remembered by whom?

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: Not whom. The grammar makes the root the subject.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Read the warning before the poetry.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: 'Do not give the sap fresh terror, for it returns the hunter and the hunted without knowing the difference.'

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Then the wretches are not dead souls.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: They may be memories with enough structure to move.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: The stone box has a pressure latch and absolutely no written suggestion that opening it is wise.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We leave it closed.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The tablet also says the lattice can quiet an awakened route.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Or wake every shape stored around it.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We copy the tablet and leave the box.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: The floor behind us has started breathing.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# The Sunken Hall Debate

Ancient grammar gives the party a theory of amber as root memory. They decide against opening the reliquary until the hall itself blocks retreat.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Sunken Hall

observations.text: The same gold root is painted through hunters, prey, and human mourners without separating their bodies.
Every animal tooth around the reliquary was cut from a jaw after death and arranged by species.
The oldest inscription treats the buried root as the acting mind and people as passing impressions.
The warning describes returned forms as unable to distinguish hunter from hunted, not as conscious dead.
Dust rises and falls through cracks behind the party in the rhythm of a sleeping chest.

author_constraints: The tablet is reliable ancient evidence but not a complete scientific account.
Opening the reliquary is a coerced tactical choice, not Veyra casually ignoring Rhea.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Sunken Hall

The ruins provide the campaign's first defensible ontology: amber is remembered form in a buried living network. The immediate need to escape keeps that revelation from becoming safe scholarship.

recollection.summary: The tablet says amber is root memory and fresh terror returns hunter and hunted without distinction. The party opened the reliquary only after retreat closed.
recollection.interpretation: The practical question is no longer whether amber causes wretches but who knew the handling rules and kept mining.

recollection.summary: The hall treats animal, human, hunter, and prey as impressions in one root system; the reliquary is ringed by deliberately catalogued teeth.
recollection.interpretation: The Frontier's animal silence may be avoidance of a memory ecology older than settlement.

recollection.summary: The inscription says returned forms cannot distinguish hunter from hunted, contradicting his belief that wretches are conscious dead souls.
recollection.interpretation: Mercy must address repeated pain without pretending a person remains inside every shape.

recollection.summary: Ancient grammar names the root as the remembering subject and amber as golden sap retaining wounded forms.
recollection.interpretation: The Heartwood may be an enormous distributed memory rather than a conventional magical creature.

recollection.summary: The party chose not to open the reliquary until the return floor began moving; its lattice is designed to quiet routes but also records nearby shadows.
recollection.interpretation: Ancient safety devices require inputs that can become new hazards.

operations.title: The Sunken Hall Releases a Pack of Remembered Beasts
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Sunken Hall Releases a Pack of Remembered Beasts

The opened lattice quiets the hall behind them but wakes a gallery ahead. Pale forms of cave lion, elk, wolf, miner, and something winged phase through pillars, changing prey and predator anatomy whenever the party shows fear.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Escape the Wretch Gallery
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Escape the Wretch Gallery

Pip finds an air shaft disguised as a carved tree trunk. Garran uses the reliquary lattice as a moving threshold while Rhea and Sylvi retreat without feeding the pack fresh panic. Veyra closes the lattice only after their shadows stop multiplying.

operations.title: The Party Emerges on a Hilltop Deep in the Frontier
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Party Emerges on a Hilltop Deep in the Frontier

After climbing the shaft for hours, the party pushes through root mat into cold dawn. No road, field smoke, or river landmark is visible—only unbroken boreal forest and unfamiliar ridgelines.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen See Smoke from a Masked Camp
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen See Smoke from a Masked Camp

From the hilltop Sylvi sees thin smoke two valleys north. Pip's glass reveals wooden animal masks moving around a palisade and a single unmasked man wearing a crown of living roots. With no food and no known direction to Harrowcross, the party approaches under a white cloth.

frontmatter.title: Wretch Gallery

observations.text: Each wretch shifts between predator and prey anatomy while retaining the same moving amber outline.
When Rhea imagines losing the others, the nearest wretch grows five human hands around its throat.
A cold draft carries spruce pollen through a vertical carving shaped like a tree trunk.
The open reliquary lattice makes the pack hesitate at an invisible moving boundary.
Every fresh panic adds a new shadow-layer inside the lattice; controlled breathing stops the multiplication.

author_constraints: The pack responds to felt fear, not merely spoken fear.
The party escapes by emotional discipline and spatial ingenuity rather than killing every manifestation.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Wretch Gallery

The gallery stress-tests the new amber theory under pursuit. Knowledge helps only when the party changes how it feels and moves, not when it becomes exposition.

frontmatter.title: Hilltop Dawn

observations.text: The hill overlooks forest in every direction without road smoke, farm clearing, or the River Keld.
The dawn angle places them far north and east of every mapped road in Pip's case.
Jorund's map and Pip's underground route cannot be reconciled with any known surface contour.
A narrow column of smoke rises two valleys north from a camp where animal-faced figures move in silence.
The unmasked figure's root crown contains amber that pulses in time with the reliquary under her coat.

author_constraints: The party does not know the Tree King's identity or Moth's role.
Approaching the camp is a survival decision under hunger and isolation, not implausible trust.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Hilltop Dawn

The underground arc ends with apparent escape and a worse isolation. The first human camp in sight belongs to someone already resonating with what the party carries.

# Sylvi Ashdown's view of Pip Fenlock

A directional relationship in The Frontiersmen. Sylvi appreciates that Pip can move quietly and knows when not to talk.

transitions.note: The party wins access to the sealed drift.
The company crosses the green lamp line.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Enter Saint Orra's Mine

Investigate the sealed drifts and missing lower crew despite Jorund's resistance.

transitions.note: The mine collapses between the party and the surface.
The party finds lower air and a viable route away from the collapse.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Escape the Cave-In

Survive the collapse, find an alternate route, and keep the company together underground.

transitions.note: The party enters unmapped lower caverns.
The lower route reaches constructed ruins and a new navigational frame.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Cross the Lower Caverns

Travel through two days of unmapped cavern systems with dwindling food and lamps.

transitions.note: The party begins reading the Sunken Hall.
Veyra translates the central amber warning.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Decode the Sunken Hall

Interpret the old reliefs and tablet describing amber as a vessel for remembered forms.

transitions.note: The reliquary wakes a gallery of remembered beasts.
The party reaches the surface shaft.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Escape the Wretch Gallery

Cross a ruin gallery where wretches can emerge from every carved surface.

transitions.note: A cold shaft offers the first surface route.
The party emerges onto the isolated hilltop.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Reach the Surface

Find an exit from the cavern system and establish where the party has emerged.

transitions.note: The only nearby human camp belongs to a masked host and an amber-crowned man.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Understand the Tree King

Learn why the masked king can harness amber and whether his communion with the Frontier is real.

transitions.note: The party is alive but isolated beyond mapped roads.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Return to Harrowcross

Find a route back to the abandoned duty post with warning and evidence.

transitions.note: Tillo supplies a partial operational vocabulary for quick amber.
The tablet and underground behavior support a root-memory theory.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# What Is Amber?

Separate frontier superstition, guild euphemism, ancient record, and the Tree King's claims into a defensible theory.
